seo.title: Gym Management Software: Memberships, Check-in and Billing
seo.description: Nexus Gym runs your club's front desk: memberships, check-in, payments, classes and reports. It keeps working even when the internet connection drops.

items.question: Does Nexus Gym need an internet connection?
items.answer: No. The front desk works on a local database. An internet connection is only needed for updates and optional backups.

items.question: Can you import our current members?
items.answer: Yes. We can import members and subscriptions from your spreadsheets or from your previous system.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The licence price depends on the number of branches and workstations. Book a demo and we will send you a quote.
